name: Grendel Jinx
source:
Class representative, although generally disliked by her peers.

Is taught by Miss Potts for most classes.

Despite her small stature, she can defend herself in a fight, both against class mates and the protagonist when need be.

She carries a stun gun with her most of the time (and freely uses it against the protagonist), as well an electro-knife
